# Albert Ellis Institute

> The Albert Ellis Institute advances rational emotive behavior therapy (REBT) and cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) through training, clinical services, and mental health resources worldwide.

Founded on the principles of Albert Ellis, the institute provides professional REBT/CBT certification programs, psychotherapy services, therapist directories, and educational materials for mental health professionals and the public. The organization combines clinical practice with professional development and research in evidence-based psychological treatment.

## Key Topics

- REBT (Rational Emotive Behavior Therapy)

## Core Services & Therapy

- [Albert Ellis Institute](https://albertellis.org): Homepage for Albert Ellis Institute, featuring REBT/CBT training and services
- [Psychotherapy: Short-Term Therapy, Long-Term Results](https://albertellis.org/psychotherapy): Psychotherapy services including anger management and group therapy programs
- [Center for Psychological Evaluation](https://albertellis.org/center-for-psychological-evaluation): Psychological testing, assessment services, and diagnostic evaluations
- [Friday Night Live! @ AEI™](https://albertellis.org/product/friday-night-live-aei): Live hybrid REBT psychotherapy event featuring Drs. Doyle and DiGiuseppe

## Professional Training & Certification

- [Trainings - REBT Certification & Professional Courses](https://albertellis.org/product-category/trainings): REBT certification and professional training courses with advanced certificates
- [Workshops - Professional Development](https://albertellis.org/product-category/workshops): REBT/CBT workshops for professional development and clinical practice
- [Clinical Externships/Internships/Fellowships](https://albertellis.org/professional-rebt-cbt/externships-fellowships): Clinical training programs in REBT/CBT with supervision and certification

## Find a Therapist & Resources

- [Find an REBT Therapist Worldwide](https://albertellis.org/find-a-therapist): Directory to find REBT therapists worldwide with search and filter options
- [About Us - Albert Ellis Institute](https://albertellis.org/about-us): Institute history, Albert Ellis biography, and REBT therapy overview

## Products & Educational Materials

- [Shop - Albert Ellis Institute](https://albertellis.org/shop-by-category): Product catalog featuring books, audio/video, trainings, and merchandise
- [Audio & Video - REBT Resources](https://albertellis.org/product-category/audio-video): Audio and video products on REBT therapy and mental health resources

## Research & Publications

- [Journal of Rational-Emotive & Cognitive-Behavior Therapy](https://albertellis.org/call-for-papers-for-a-special-issue-of-the-journal-of-rebt-cbt): Journal of Rational-Emotive & Cognitive-Behavior Therapy publication guidelines

## Optional Resources
